text: You walk into the supermarket, list in hand, ready to grab your essentials and get out as quickly as possible.
A gentle, often familiar melody drifts through the air, barely noticeable. You move through the aisles, focused on your task.
You might pause to consider an item, assuming the soft tunes are just for a pleasant atmosphere, nothing more than background noise.
But this isn't just ambiance. Its slow tempo is a hidden system, subtly designed to gently pull down your walking speed and extend your stay.
The longer you linger in the store, the more shelves you scan, the more likely you are to toss extra items into your trolley.
Next time you hear that soothing supermarket soundtrack, you'll know it's not just a mood setter. It's a quiet conductor, guiding your pace, and your wallet.
